subsystem: Browser transport for the retained high-level C device
implementation: Thin typed C API; handwritten bounded integer-only JSON serialization; no CPU instruction execution, floating-point formatter or host calculator arithmetic.

api_contract.arguments: Unsigned32 transport validates variant and raw-pair widths at255; elapsed flag must be0or1; JavaScript validates safe integers before WASM coercion.
api_contract.step: Exactly one public semantic controller step, with no physical-input provider.
api_contract.timers: The C API acknowledges only actual pending timers. The optional browser scheduler accelerates those semantic delays on animation frames; physical timing is not emulated.
api_contract.memory: Opaque C device owns full64KiB RAM/MMIO and controller state.
api_contract.snapshot: Allocated JSON observation; immutable after creation and valid after reset or session destruction until snapshot_free.
api_contract.serialization: Fixed schema and controlled status/hex strings; bounded4096bytes; exact signed32 and unsigned32 integer output.

limits: Original device RAM/controller parity is covered by separate native oracle tests; the thin bridge tests compare against the real public C session API.
Browser/WASM tests compare exported JSON and LCD, with no claim of public full64KiB WASM RAM parity.
No whole-device completion, physical timing or advanced unsupported-screen claim.
Ordinary browser calculations remain available through the separate prepared-expression interface.

browser_scheduler.keypress: One authored raw packet, bounded real controller progression, actual key release and settling to a retained boundary.
browser_scheduler.limits: 40steps per segment and8actual pending timer acknowledgments per released segment. Requests, export, reset and invalid states stop progression.
browser_scheduler.startup: Controls and policies locked during module load and boot; failures remain visible.
browser_scheduler.diagnostics: 128displayed actual operation records; observable post-call events for independent test collection.
browser_scheduler.manual: Automatic key processing and timers can be disabled for explicit inspection.
